summary: First-finish smoke test on AquaSuíno. All 9 backend endpoints tested pass (GET propriedades/detail/dashboards, POST leituras/dejetos/propriedades/alertas-resolver, GET PDF). All 3 dashboards (Produtor, Frivatti, Prefeitura) load without JS errors and render KPIs + charts + data (11 propriedades incl. one created via POST test). Nova-leitura dialog opens with input-leitura-m3 present. No console errors.
passed: GET /api/propriedades -> 200, returns 10 seeded properties (11 after POST test)
GET /api/propriedades/{id} -> 200, has propriedade, leituras(10), dejetos(10), alertas(1), resumo (all required keys)
GET /api/dashboard/prefeitura -> 200, economia_m3=506.5 (screenshot 259.266 aggregated), biogas_m3, retorno_economico_brl, municipios, propriedades
POST /api/dejetos -> 200, biogas_m3 = volume_kg * 0.062 = 62.0 for 1000 kg (Embrapa factor correct)
Landing renders hero, 4 steps (Medir/Reduzir/Tratar/Reaproveitar), 3 role selectors
Produtor dashboard loads, charts render (Consumo x Meta line, Biogás x Dejetos bar), Nova leitura + Registrar dejetos buttons visible
Frivatti dashboard renders 4 KPI cards + Ranking chart + Biogás chart + Exportar PDF button
Prefeitura dashboard renders 4 KPIs (259.266 m³ economia, 880.036 m³ biogás, R$ 794.772, 55% adesão) + pie chart + aggregate panel
Nova leitura dialog opens with input-leitura-m3 field
No JS/console errors on any page
